_comment: Workflow template (design 5.8.1; implementation plan P4-08), served by
GET /api/v1/templates. `document` is a complete workflow document; creating a
workflow from it copies it with a new workflow ID and new node and edge IDs.
Model fields are left empty: the builder fills them with the deployment's
DEFAULT_MODEL_ID, as it does for a new node. Tests require every template to
pass the workflow JSON Schema and the validation rules with no errors.
name: question-answering-with-tools
